title: Fails to parse "range syntax" in container style queries
impact: 6 reactions plus a 'just ran into this' comment (Apr 2026). Strict mode (the default, e.g. Vite cssMinify / Tailwind v4) errors on CSS that now works in Chrome 142+ and Firefox 151+. Workaround: errorRecovery, which keeps the rule as written with a warning. Assigned to yisibl (member) since Apr 2026; no PR yet.
code: src/media_query.rs: QueryFeature range/interval parsing and MediaFeatureComparison (reusable for <mf-comparison>)
summary: `@container style(--x > 10)`, `style(1em < 20px)` and `style(10 < --x <= 20)` fail with 'Unexpected token' in strict mode, including inside `style((--x > 1) or (--y: 2))`. css-conditional-5 adds <style-range> to <style-feature>; it has shipped in two engines, so this is a missing feature rather than a draft-flag candidate.
repro: 1069-repro.mjs. `@container style(--x > 10){.a{color:red}}` -> ERROR: Unexpected token Delim('>') on local master, 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1. With errorRecovery: output identical to input plus a warning.
evidence: repro.mjs on local master + 1.31.1..1.33.0: all 4 range cases error; controls (errorRecovery passthrough; plain/boolean style features) pass. Spec: css-conditional-5 ED (Overview.bs, Status ED, Work Status Exploring) defines `<style-feature> = <style-feature-plain> | <style-feature-boolean> | <style-range>`, `<style-range> = <style-range-value> <mf-comparison> <style-range-value> | <style-range-value> <mf-lt> <style-range-value> <mf-lt> <style-range-value> | ...gt...`, `<style-range-value> = <custom-property-name> | <style-feature-value>`; values are substituted (var()/attr()) and parsed as number/percentage/length/angle/time/frequency/resolution at evaluation time. MDN BCD 8.0.7 (css.at-rules.container.style_queries_for_custom_properties.range_syntax): Chrome/Edge 142, Firefox 151, Safari false. Chromium 153 probe: conditionText round-trips `style(--x > 10)`, `style(1em < 20px)`, `style(10 < --x <= 20)`.

fix.approach: Add a StyleQuery::Range variant (plain comparison and interval forms) whose operands are a custom-property name or a TokenList (<style-feature-value> is an arbitrary <declaration-value> resolved at evaluation time, so tokens are the spec'd type). In parse, after a custom-property name, look ahead for a comparison delim before treating it as a declaration; otherwise parse a leading value up to the comparison. Reuse MediaFeatureComparison for <mf-comparison> parsing/serialization. JS AST: additive union case only. No lowering possible, so no compat entry needed beyond pass-through.

notVerified: Safari/WebKit implementation plans (WebKit standards-positions, bug tracker) not checked; BCD shows Safari unsupported as of July 2026. Not checked whether open CSSWG issues propose changing the <style-range> grammar.
